metadata.description: Claude Code mods for keeping long sessions healthy: see how full the context window is, and hand off to a fresh window before it degrades.

plugins.name: context-handoff
plugins.description: When the context grows heavy, offers to continue from the same point in a fresh window, with a full handoff written by the model.

plugins.name: token-weather
plugins.description: Anthropic's sample mod: a forecast of the context window above the prompt, patched to share that band with other mods.
